records.question: Why does dropout help reduce overfitting?
records.raw: Dropout helps reduce overfitting by breaking up co-adaptation among neurons, which is a state where each layer relies on a specific pattern of activations from the previous layer [C3]. This is analogous to how sexual reproduction breaks up co-adapted genes [C3]. By randomly dropping out neurons during training, dropout prevents the network from relying too heavily on any single neuron or pattern of activations [C1][C3]. This regularization effect reduces overfitting by forcing the network to learn more robust and generalized features [C1][C2].

records.question: What is the purpose of the forget gate in an LSTM?
records.raw: The purpose of the forget gate in an LSTM is to determine how much of the old cell internal state should be retained. It decides whether to keep the current value of the memory or flush it. This allows the model to control the flow of information by retaining or discarding past states based on the input.
